channel.title: Windek Oil and Gas Limited Insights
channel.description: Analysis on Nigerian LPG infrastructure, local content on EPCI projects, gas flaring and commercial energy decisions.

item.title: Solving Nigeria's LPG Storage Deficit
item.description: Nigeria produces LPG in abundance yet consumers still face shortages. The bottleneck is bulk storage capacity, and closing it changes delivered gas economics.

item.title: Why Local Content Matters on EPCI Projects
item.description: EPCI combines four phases into one contract, making local capability a delivery advantage rather than a compliance checkbox. Here is how that works.

item.title: Understanding Gas Flaring in Nigeria
item.description: Associated gas is burned at the wellhead because there is nowhere to put it. That single infrastructure gap explains most of Nigeria's flaring problem.

item.title: Choosing an LPG Storage Partner
item.description: Capacity, location and delivery record matter more than headline tonnage. A checklist for operators and distributors evaluating storage providers.
